query: What is the current status of the 2026 Tour de France as of 13 July 2026? Latest general classification standings, has Tadej Pogačar retained the yellow jersey, any crashes or abandonments, current gap to Vingegaard.
answer:
## Summary

**As of 13 July 2026, following Stage 10 (Bastille Day):**

- **Yellow jersey: Retained by Tadej Pogačar.** He didn't just hold it — he won Stage 10 (Aurillac → Le Lioran, 166.6 km) with a solo attack ~15 km from the finish, his 3rd stage win of the race.

- **Gap to Vingegaard: 3 minutes 36 seconds.** This widened on 13 July — the lead was 2:42 after Stage 9 and grew to 3:36 after Pogačar's Stage 10 win, with Vingegaard dropped in the finale.

- **GC top 3:** 1) Pogačar (36:15:02); 2) Vingegaard +3:36; 3) Evenepoel +4:06 (Evenepoel now only 30s behind Vingegaard).

- **Crashes/abandonments:** ~9–10 riders out through Stage 10. Headline losses: pre-race GC hope **Cian Uijtdebroeks** (Stage 6, Tourmalet), **Torstein Træen** (concussion + rib fractures), and **Chris Harper**, who crashed on Stage 10 itself with a serious thumb injury and did not start Stage 11.

One clarification: the query date of 13 July corresponds to the completion of **Stage 10**, not Stage 13. Some live-tracker sources reference later stages, but those pertain to subsequent race dates. Full report with sources and structured data provided above.

key_facts: Stage 10 was raced on 13 July 2026 (Bastille Day), Aurillac to Le Lioran, 166.6 km — the most recent stage completed as of the query date.
Tadej Pogačar retained the yellow jersey and won Stage 10 with a solo attack ~15 km from the line (his 3rd stage win of the 2026 Tour, 24th career TdF stage win).
Pogačar's GC lead over Jonas Vingegaard grew from 2:42 (after Stage 9) to 3:36 (after Stage 10).
GC top 3 after Stage 10: 1) Pogačar 36:15:02; 2) Vingegaard +3:36; 3) Evenepoel +4:06.
Vingegaard was unexpectedly dropped in the Stage 10 finale, finishing ~12 seconds behind runner-up Evenepoel; Evenepoel closed to within 30 seconds of Vingegaard.
Approximately 9–10 riders had abandoned by Stage 10; withdrawal count was low but injuries (concussions, rib/collarbone fractures) made the first week attritional.
Cian Uijtdebroeks (Movistar, pre-race GC hope) abandoned Stage 6 on the Col du Tourmalet.
Torstein Træen (Uno-X), a former yellow-jersey wearer, withdrew before Stage 7 with concussion and multiple rib fractures after a Stage 6 crash.
Chris Harper (Pinarello Q36.5) crashed on Stage 10 (13 July), suffered a serious left-thumb injury requiring surgery, and did not start Stage 11.

Other first-week abandons: Clément Berthet (DNS Stage 2), Arnaud De Lie (DNF Stage 3, illness), Kelland O'Brien (OTL Stage 4), Alex Molenaar (DNS Stage 6), Bert Van Lerberghe (DNF Stage 6), Arvid De Kleijn (Stage 6).
